lines: Yeh dil, yeh pagal dil mera
couplets.en: This heart, this wild heart of mine.

lines: Is dasht mein ek shahr tha, woh kya hua?
couplets.en: There was a city in this wilderness, where has it gone?

lines: Kal shab mujhe be-shakl ki aawaz ne chaunka diya
couplets.en: Last night a voice with no face startled me.

lines: Is dasht mein ek shahr tha, woh kya hua?
couplets.en: There was a city in this wilderness, where has it gone?

lines: Yeh dard ki tanhaiyan, yeh dasht ka veeran safar
couplets.en: Such solitude in sorrow, such a desolate road through the wilderness.

lines: Hum log to ukta gaye, apni suna aawargi
couplets.en: We have grown weary, restlessness, tell us how you fare.

lines: Is dasht mein ek shahr tha, woh kya hua?
couplets.en: There was a city in this wilderness, where has it gone?

lines: Ek ajnabi jhonke ne jab poochha mere gham ka sabab
couplets.en: A passing gust asked what lay behind my grief.

lines: Sehra ki bheegi ret par maine likha, aawargi
couplets.en: On the wet desert sand I wrote, restlessness.

lines: Is dasht mein ek shahr tha, woh kya hua?
couplets.en: There was a city in this wilderness, where has it gone?

lines: Kal raat tanha chand ko dekha tha maine khwab mein
couplets.en: Last night I saw the lonely moon in a dream.

lines: Kal raat tanha chand ko dekha tha maine khwab mein
couplets.en: Last night I saw the lonely moon in a dream.

lines: Mohsin, mujhe raas aayegi shayad sada aawargi
couplets.en: Perhaps, Mohsin, a life of wandering will always suit me.

lines: Dil, yeh pagal dil mera kyun bujh gaya?
couplets.en: Why did this wild heart of mine go dark?

lines: Is dasht mein ek shahr tha, woh kya hua?
couplets.en: There was a city in this wilderness, where has it gone?

lines: Yeh pagal dil mera kyun bujh gaya, aawargi, aawargi?
couplets.en: Restlessness, why did this wild heart of mine go dark?
